verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer ships client-facing software (GDHQ, the Contract Generator, the D&O Portal, Catalyze, and the internal ChatGD), so a sandbox or test environment is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment for any of these tools. The probes also found no public API surface (OpenAPI and llms.txt all return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
